item.name: 11. Sponsor Covenant (Brain Invariant #5 — Local Sponsor Covenant)
item.description:
T3 (Newman against staging) coverage of Brain Invariant #5: the Local Sponsor Covenant. On any event with mixed-locality sponsors, local sponsors MUST appear in the resolved sponsor list BEFORE non-local sponsors regardless of pricing tier; within each group, tier breaks ties.

Test pyramid context — this section is the network-staging layer. Companions:
  • L0 structural: tests/e2e/0-architecture/tier-equity.invariant.spec.ts (code shape)
  • L0 schema:     workers/oursharedevents/tests/schema.spec.ts + constraints.spec.ts + shared-report-pipeline-invariants.spec.ts
  • L0 drift:      workers/oursharedevents/tests/sponsor-allocation-drift-check.spec.ts (brain↔OSE)
  • L1 in-process: workers/oursharedevents/tests/tier-equity-sort.spec.ts (7 cases via SELF.fetch in miniflare)
  • L3 (this):     covenant assertion against deployed worker on stg.oursharedevents.com

Flow per run:
  1. seed 4 sponsors on test-event-001 with mixed (is_local × tier) — stable IDs prefixed `covenant-fixture-` so re-runs upsert rather than duplicate
  2. assert GET /api/v2/events/test-event-001/sponsors returns them in covenant order:
     locals first (platinum-local, bronze-local), then non-locals by tier (title-nonlocal, bronze-nonlocal)
  3. cleanup — DELETE the 4 fixture sponsors

Requires CF Access service token in env (cfAccessClientId + cfAccessClientSecret) — seed/cleanup POST/DELETE hit /api/v2/admin/* which CF Access shadows at edge. Without the service token the seed step's CF-Access-Blocked branch fails the test with an actionable message (the covenant cannot be proven if seeding cannot succeed).
